reference.title: AT+MHTTPCFG Parameters Setting
reference.shortdesc: This command configures general parameters for the instances.

row.entry: Syntax
Response
Test commandAT+MHTTPCFG=?
If succeed: +MHTTPCFG: (list of supported <cmd>s),(list of supported <httpid>s), OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>
Read command AT+MHTTPCFG?

If succeed: [+MHTTPCFG: "header",<httpid>[,<header_len>,<header>] +MHTTPCFG: "chunked",<httpid>,<chunked_mode> +MHTTPCFG: "cached",<httpid>,<cached>[,<cache_length>] +MHTTPCFG: "timeout",<httpid>,<conn_timeout>,<rsp_timeout>,<input_timeout> +MHTTPCFG: "encoding",<httpid>,<input_format>,<output_format> +MHTTPCFG: "ssl",<httpid>,<ssl_enable>[,<ssl_id>] +MHTTPCFG: "cid",<httpid>[,<cid>] +MHTTPCFG: "fragment",<httpid>,<frag_size>,<interval> +MHTTPCFG: "urlencode",<httpid>,<urlencode_mode> [...]] OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>
Set command (general header setting) AT+MHTTPCFG="header"[,<httpid>[,<header>]]

Set command (WTCP mode settings)Currently, only the ML307B supports "wtcp mode settings". AT+MHTTPCFG="wtcp"[,<avoid_enable>[,<option_kind>]]

If succeed

+MHTTPCFG: "wtcp",<avoid_enable>[,<option_kind>] OK

OK
If fail:
+CME ERROR: <err>
Command Description

The READ command returns all configuration parameters of all created instances; in the SET command, if only <cmd> (command identifier) is specified, it returns the current configuration parameters of all created instances. If only <cmd> and <httpid> (client instance ID) are specified, it returns the current configuration parameters of the specified instance. If other parameters are also specified, the corresponding mode will be configured. Parameter configuration can only be performed after the instance is created.
Parameter Description

<cmd>Command identifier.
MN318/MN328/ML307H-GU: both "ssl" setting and "ssl" encrypted transmission are not supported.
MN316/MN326: "cid" setting is not supported.
MN327: "ssl" setting is not supported.
MN319/MN319-A/MN316A/MN326A/M5310-E: both "ssl" & "cid" setting, and "ssl" encrypted transmission are not supported.
Currently, only the ML307B supports the "wtcp" setting.

plentry.pd: General header setting applies throughout the instance life cycle. When configuring, fields must be set in the format key: value. The module saves all configured fields.

Transmission mode setting. The use flow differs between the standard mode (Content-Length mode) and the chunked mode. In standard mode, the content data is set first before sending the request. In chunked mode, the request is sent first before setting the content data.
Cache mode setting. When configured in cache mode, received data will be buffered in the module. A notification is reported upon request completion, and the data must be manually read by the user.
Timeout setting. It includes connection timeout, response timeout, and data input timeout.
SSL enable setting. It is used for HTTPS.
Data output flow control setting. It is used for controlling packetized output during data printing.
URL encoding setting. When enabled, the module automatically encodes the requested path, excluding alphanumeric characters and the symbols such as : -_.!~*'();/?:@&=+$,#.
Wtcp mode settings, including whether to bypass wtcp and the TCP options configuration values selected when bypassing.

row.entry: <httpid>Client Instance id. Returned upon successful AT+MHTTPCREATE with range: 0-3. MN319/MN319-A/MN316A/MN326A: <httpid> parameter range 0-1.
<header_len>General header length.

<header>General header applies throughout the instance life cycle. It must be configured by fields in the key: value form. The module stores all configured fields. ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML307M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307H/ML307N: <header> parameter input length range 1-1024.
<chunked_mode>Transmission mode. Default value: 0.
<cached>Cache mode. Default value: 0.

<cache_length>Cache size. Default value 4K (4096 bytes), 1-8192 bytes. When <cached>=0 (non-cache mode), the <cache_length> parameter will not be displayed in query result. MN316A/MN326A supported range: 1-4096 bytes.
<conn_timeout>Connection timeout 0-180 s. Default value: 60 s.
<rsp_timeout>Service response timeout 0-60 s. Default value: 0 s (no timeout).

<input_timeout>Data input timeout 0-180 s. Default value: 10 s. (Data input through AT commands by using the > mode input.)
M5310-E/MN328/MN318/MN316/MN319/MN319-A/MN326/MN316A/MN326A: data mode input is not supported; therefore, thus <input_timeout> parameter settings are not supported.
ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML305U/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307M/ML307H/ML307X/ML307Y/MR380R/MR380M: supported range 1-120 s.
ML307N: supported range 0-120 s.

<input_format>Data input encoding mode. Default value: 0. The module converts input data to raw data according to the configured encoding format. This parameter affects data input for the following commands: AT+MHTTPCFG="header", AT+MHTTPHEADER, AT+MHTTPCONTENT and AT+MHTTPREQUEST. MR880A does not support 2.

<output_format>Data output encoding mode. Default value: 0. The module converts raw data to specified encoding format according to the configured encoding format. This parameter affects data output of URC reporting for the following commands: +MHTTPURC: "header", +MHTTPURC: "content".
<ssl_enable>SSL enable. Default value: 0.

plentry.pd: No use of SSL (general connection, HTTP)

row.entry:
<ssl_id>SSL context index specifies the SSL context used by the current instance. Valid range refers to the document "SSL User Manual". ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML307S/ML305U/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307X/ML307Y/ML307M/ML307H-DU/ML307N/ML307H-MU: <ssl_id> parameter range 0-5.
ML307N: Once <ssl_id> is successfully set for the first time, subsequent configurations will default to the current parameter.
MR380R: <ssl_id> cannot be omitted when enabled.

<cid>PDP context id specifies the PDP context used by the current instance. Valid range is platform dependent.
M5310-E/MN316/MN319/MN319-A/MN326/MN316A/MN326A: The <cid> parameter setting is not currently supported; the default value is unspecified.
MN318/MN328: Default unspecified. When it is explicitly specified, ensure the CID is already activated.
ML302S/ML307S: <cid> parameter setting supported. Default value: 1. MN327: Range 1-7; not specified by default; if specified, ensure that CID support is enabled.
ML305U: <cid> parameter setting supported with the range 1-7. Default value: 1.
ML307G/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307H/ML307X/ML307Y/ML307M/ML307N/MR380R: Supports the <cid> parameter setting; this is not specified by default. If specified, ensure that the supported CID has been activated.
MR880A: <cid> parameter 7 supported only.
MR380M: Supports the <cid> parameter setting; this is not specified by default, with a range of 2-10. If specified, ensure that the supported CID has been activated.

<frag_size>Maximum packet size for received data reporting with size range: 0-1024 bytes. Default value: 0 (actual received packet size output). Packet segmentation performs sub-packeting on received network packets. For example, when receiving a 1400-byte packet with <frag_size>=500, the data will be output in 3 segments (500, 500, 400).
<interval>Time intervals of packet segmentation output for received data with range: 0-2000 ms. Default value: 0 (no interval between packets).
<urlencode_mode>URL encoding enable. Default value: 0.

plentry.pd: Encoding (no encoding for alphanumeric and special characters, such as -_.!~*'();/?:@&=+$,#.)

row.entry: <avoid_enable>wtcp mode, default value 1.
<option_kind>TCP options configuration value, range: 8-254, default value: 208.
Example

Test command AT+MHTTPCFG=? +MHTTPCFG: ("header","chunked","cached","timeout","encoding","ssl","cid","fragment","urlencode"),(0-3), OK Header setting AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0,"Connection: close" OK Header query AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0 +MHTTPCFG: "header",0,19,Connection: close OK

sl.sli: In the module's default header, the standard mode includes the Host and Content-Length fields and the Chunked mode includes the Host and Transfer-Encoding fields. Header configuration is implemented via two commands: AT+MHTTPCFG="header" command sets the general header that applies throughout the instance life cycle; AT+MHTTPHEADER command sets the specific header that applies only to a single request, primarily used for dynamic fields that vary between requests. If the same field exists in both general and specific headers, the module automatically replaces it with the configured value of the specific header when sending the request.
The length of a single AT command input is constrained by the platform's limit. For data exceeding this limit, multiple inputs are recommended.

ML307B: In the wtcp mode configuration, it is not recommended to modify the TCP options configuration value unless necessary. The default value is 0, which means the base station wtcp is not bypassed.
